jobs.title: Retail Security Supervisor Lead a Team in Mesquite, TX
jobs.description: Marksman Security is seeking a Retail Security Officer to supervise operations on an assigned client site. You will report to the Site Supervisor/Director and manage security staff, ensuring high-quality service to protect people and property. Qualifications include a High School diploma or GED, 3 years of security experience, a valid Level II Texas Security License, and a valid driver's license. English literacy is required, with bilingual considered a plus.

jobs.title: Retail Security Supervisor: Grow Your Career at $15.61/hr
jobs.description:

The role involves supervising client-site operations, managing a team of security officers, and ensuring high-quality security services to protect people and property. Responsibilities include coaching staff, handling emergencies, maintaining logs, and following post orders.
